quest.title: Michelle Never Stops!
quest.description: Michelle is on her way to work, looking quite exhausted...

dialogues.speaker: Michelle
dialogues.text: Ow, my back...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you okay?

dialogues.speaker: Michelle
dialogues.text: I was just getting ready for work, but then all of a sudden my back started hurting.

dialogues.speaker: Michelle
dialogues.text: I promised Quinn I would go and help out at his fruit stand today, but I think it's best if I rest here for a while first...

dialogues.speaker: Michelle
dialogues.text: But I can't just stay here and hold everything up.

dialogues.speaker: Michelle
dialogues.text: Could you go and ask Quinn what he needs me to do? That will help me get prepared.

response.speaker: Michelle
response.text: Thank you. I should be fine after a short rest.

choices.text: It's not far, surely you can make it?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Come on, is this really so much to ask? Help me out here.

dialogues.speaker: Michelle
dialogues.text: Have you spoken to Quinn?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes. He says you should get some rest.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There's nothing to do at Quinn's today anyway, go home and rest up.

dialogues.speaker: Michelle
dialogues.text: Really... *sigh* Looks like I should find something else to do...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What? You're not going to take a sick day!? Take the chance while it's there!

dialogues.speaker: Michelle
dialogues.text: Stop and feel what is happening all around you. That's Lord Barbatos' winds, still hard at work.

dialogues.speaker: Michelle
dialogues.text: We are blessed by Barbatos. It is not a privilege we should take lightly — we all need to do our part.

dialogues.speaker: Michelle
dialogues.text: As for your part... What have you been doing? Why are you sweating so much?

dialogues.speaker: Michelle
dialogues.text: It seems that you are very busy yourself. But this is not a bad thing, for the more we toil, the more we sweat, and the more keenly we feel the winds of Barbatos.

dialogues.speaker: Michelle
dialogues.text: Here, have this bottle of milk. Drink up and get back to it, for there is no shortage of work to be done in this world.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa... This looks like really tough work.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Michelle has enough on her plate already. Let's help Quinn finish the job off ourselves.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And then let's beg him to give Michelle something that's a bit more manageable...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hopefully Michelle won't mind us stepping in on her behalf like this.

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: Where is my delivery? This is ridiculous...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's happened?

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: *sigh* My fruit stall is all out of sunsettias. I ordered several batches a while ago...

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: But they still haven't arrived. And my customers won't wait forever.

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: Eury alone has come by three times already, and all she wants is <color=#00E1FFFF>three sunsettias</color>. She's been a regular customer for a long time, and now I'm afraid I might lose her!

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: I need to stay at the stall... If only someone could go and pick a few wild sunsettias for me.

choices.text: If it's urgent, I can go.

response.speaker: Quinn
response.text: Really? That's amazing! Thank you so much.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hang on! What is Michelle doing picking fruit in her condition!?

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: Have you found me some sunsettias yet?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Got them right here.

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: Great. That should be enough for Miss Eury.

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: *sigh* But it looks like most of my customers have gone now. This isn't a one-person job, it seems.

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: Oh— I should give you something for your trouble. Hang on...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There is no need for gifts. But we do have a request for you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's about Michelle.

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: Michelle? You've seen her?

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: I should give her a less taxing job?

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: All I ever asked is that she watch the fruit stand for me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh. Is that true?

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: But with no more customers, it looks like I won't even need her to do that...

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: Please tell her to go home and rest for me.

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: I'll go and chase up that delivery in a moment.

dialogues.speaker: Michelle
dialogues.text: My back hurts so much... I hope I'll recover after a short rest...

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: Did you find me some <color=#00E1FFFF>sunsettias</color>?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not yet.

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: There should be plenty of <color=#00E1FFFF>sunsettias</color> just outside the city. Please, I need to stay here — can you run and grab some quickly?

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: Oh no...

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: Thank you for your help. *sigh* Next time I need to get more people on board. Maybe Beatrice? Nah...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hahaha... Well, on the bright side, at least we got some exercise...
